name: talaria-web-workspace
description: Talaria Web: npm workspaces root for the contracts package, the Node server, and the frontend. The Python sidecar lives in sidecar/ and runs on the Hermes Agent venv.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.build:fast: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build:fast -w packages/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/server && npm run typecheck -w packages/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/contracts && npm run lint -w packages/server && npm run lint -w packages/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm test -w packages/contracts && npm test -w packages/server && npm test -w packages/frontend
